أنتهز (form VIII)
# أَنْتَهِزُ (ʔantahizu) /ʔan.ta.hi.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# أُنْتَهَزُ (ʔuntahazu) /ʔun.ta.ha.zu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# أَنْتَهِزَ (ʔantahiza) /ʔan.ta.hi.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# أُنْتَهَزَ (ʔuntahaza) /ʔun.ta.ha
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
